_comment: rag+chat lane — mid-to-heavy reasoning. Collapsed from the proposal's separate rag/chat drafts (owner direction 2026-07-19: they were identical anyway; split them again later if rag and chat ever need independent tuning). Mirrors litellm-config.yaml's glm-5.1-primary / NVIDIA-backup pattern, with the Gemini 4-key rotation slotted in as a middle tier that absorbs rate-limit overflow before falling all the way to NVIDIA. Middle tier pinned to 'gemini-flash-latest', NOT 'gemini-2.5-pro': live verification 2026-07-19 found every one of the 4 keys 429'd ('exceeded current quota') on gemini-2.5-pro/gemini-pro-latest under test traffic, while gemini-flash-latest returned 200 for all keys tested. Revisit the pro tier once real usage patterns show whether that 429 was rapid-test-traffic-induced or a standing free-tier cap — see docker/gateway/portkey/README.md. EXTENDED 2026-07-19 (owner: provider-key sweep) with 3 more free/cheap tiers between Gemini and NVIDIA, plus Mistral appended as the absolute-last paid fallback (owner policy: Mistral costs money, never primary, only hit if every other tier — including NVIDIA — is down). Groq is a single target, not a loadbalance pair: the donor-.env second Groq key (candidate rotation partner) verified DEAD (401) on 2026-07-19, so only the canonical key is wired. Native Portkey provider slugs 'groq'/'cerebras'/'openrouter'/'mistral-ai' confirmed valid live (2026-07-19 probe of the pinned gateway's own error list) — no custom_host needed for these three, unlike NVIDIA/Ollama which aren't native and go through the openai-compatible custom_host path. WARNING: the openrouter tier is wired but its key is valid-but-broke — 402 'Insufficient credits' on a real completion, both directly and through this gateway, verified 2026-07-19 (the /v1/auth/key endpoint alone looked healthy and is misleading; it doesn't reflect balance). Left in the chain per owner instruction to include marked-broke providers; it will simply no-op-fallthrough to NVIDIA until topped up at https://openrouter.ai/settings/credits. Groq and Cerebras tiers ARE confirmed live end-to-end through this gateway (real completions, 2026-07-19).
